# How to Choose the Right Packers and Movers for a Stress-Free Move

** 14


[Add to Reading List](https://stownest.com/blog/login)


## Choosing between packers and movers, moving companies, and relocation services can feel confusing. Here's a simple, honest guide to picking the right one.


Checking the quote for an itemized list, ensuring that the insurance and valuation are confirmed, and double checking reviews and asking about hidden charges will give you peace of mind when choosing the right packers and movers for your next big move. The name a company goes by moving companies, relocation services, professional movers is less important than their ability to provide each of these answers.


[Packing and moving](https://stownest.com/packers-movers?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=website&utm_campaign=packers-movers) covers all the physical work involved in relocating to a new place. This includes organization, packing and transporting personal belongings, as well as setting up your belongings and house in your new location. There are some things that differentiate a stressful move from a less stressful one. This guide will help you understand the details that most people tend to overlook which will make packing and moving easier.


---


## **Why "Just Pick One" Rarely Works Out Well**


If you search for movers in any Indian city, you'll notice you have way too many options, many of which have seemingly subtle differences in their names. Some are known as packers and movers. Others match relocation services or household shifting services. Names don't tell you a lot about the quality of what you're paying for. What really makes a move stress-free and what most people don’t think to look for until it’s too late, are only a few things.


## **Start by Understanding What You're Actually Comparing**


Not all companies that offer to move your belongings do the same thing. Some moving companies transport your belongings, but expect you to do your own packing.


On the other hand, some moving companies provide a full home relocation service and do all the packing, loading, transport, unloading, and sometimes even store your belongings if needed.


Before you can compare prices, you have to know the offer that each moving company provides, because a cheaper quote from a transport-only company isn't as cheap when you consider the cost of packing supplies and the labor that you would need to take care of yourself.


---


## **How Packing and Moving Actually Works, Step by Step**


If you have never booked a move before, the booking process can be a bit confusing. Here is the booking process described step by step.


-


**[Booking movers](https://stownest.com/booking/request?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=website&utm_campaign=packers-movers)** begins with a call where you give them all the information about what you are moving, where you are moving it from, where you are moving it to, and if your new location is ready to receive your items or if there is a time gap.


-


After you are done with the call, the packing stage begins. Depending on the items you need to move, the movers will use the correct packing material to protect the items.


-


While the movers transport your items, you can appreciate some beverage on the sidelines.


-


Once your items reach their new address, they help you assemble your furniture, place your items in their respective places to avoid the hassle of having to do it yourself.


---


## **What Security and Care Actually Look Like During a Move**


Every moving company uses the word “secure”, but it’s worth looking into what it means in practice, since it means very different things to different companies.


-


Good quality packing material actually does make a difference. Using cushioning helps protect fragile items from becoming damaged. Furniture being loaded should be protected by wrapping the corners and surfaces, or they may become damaged.


-


The biggest risk factor in a move is not preventing damage, but handling furniture in and out of transport with caution. Forced furniture through narrow doors, hallways, or stairways remains a big issue in how likely damage becomes. The preventative measures to protective handling actually means taking the time to transport furniture in sections.


-


Moving companies should be held accountable for the damages that occur, even if they are as a result of careful handling. StowNest! is a moving company that offers a service where items that are damaged during storage and transport are replaced.


-


Instead of asking for a general quote, ask for an itemized list. A general quote helps nobody. A good quote will separate a breakdown of the individual components of packing, labor, transport, and other services.


-


Confirming insurance requirements in writing is vital. Insurance is not the assurance that it is covered if it is only stated verbally. Make sure they define their insurance coverage and exclusions.


-


Reviews should be verifiable, and a company should have a physical address. Some companies exist as a phone number only on aggregator listings. Selecting a company that has verifiable reviews and a visible office is the safer option.


-


Make sure to include possible hidden charges in your quote. This can be fees associated with moving, for example, for loading or unloading, access to upper floors or elevators, waiting time if the new premises are not ready, etc.


Find out what the expected duration of the move will be. Ask what happens if the move takes longer than anticipated due to unknown building access and/or traffic conditions.


---


## **Why The Right Choice Matters More Than People Think**


The negative impacts of a bad experience with household movers goes beyond the inconvenience of a stressful day. In some cases you may have your belongings received later than agreed to, or the final invoice surprises you with hidden costs. By contrast, reputable movers are upfront with their pricing and process, so customers don't find themselves surprised on moving day.

Whether you need just the move handled or storage for a gap in between, both services are available under one reliable provider across Bangalore, Hyderabad, Chennai, Mumbai, Pune, Delhi, and Kolkata.


---


## **Key Takeaways**


-


Not all moving service providers are equal. Some will do everything, while others do just the transport.


-


When looking for pricing, do not look at total price comparisons. See if you can request an itemized list so you can see if you’re getting your money’s worth.


-


Insurance coverage is best confirmed in writing as opposed to verbal confirmation.


-


Before the move, check on loading fees, requests for floor access, and waiting time charges.


-


In general, a moving services provider that has a real address and reviews that are not made up is probably safe to do business with.


---


## **Frequently Asked Questions**


**1. How do I select the best packers and movers for a stress free relocation?**


Ensure they offer an itemized quote, confirmed insurance, and reviews. Ask about any hidden costs.


**2. What is the difference between packers and movers and a transport company?**


Packers and movers typically include all aspects of the move and transport, while some transport companies only offer moving services and expect the customer to take care of packing.


**3. What do I need to ask professional movers to book?**


Ask about the cost, insurance,and security they provide . Ask about any possible surcharges due to waiting or floor time. Confirm everything.


**4. How does the packing and moving process work?**

**5. What safety precautions do packers and movers take?**
